fields.label: Document Type
fields.description: DocType on which this Workflow is applicable.

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Activating a workflow without conditions deactivates the other workflows of this document type that have no conditions.

fields.label: Don't Override Status
fields.description: If Checked workflow status will not override status in list view

fields.label: Send Email Alert
fields.description: Emails will be sent with next possible workflow actions

fields.label: Enable Action Confirmation
fields.description: If checked, a confirmation will be required before performing workflow actions.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Workflows with a higher priority are matched first.
Restrict this workflow to documents matching all of these conditions. Leave empty to apply it to every document of this type.

fields.label: States
fields.description: Different "States" this document can exist in. Like "Open", "Pending Approval" etc.

fields.label: Document States
fields.description: All possible Workflow States and roles of the workflow. Docstatus Options: 0 is "Saved", 1 is "Submitted" and 2 is "Cancelled"

fields.label: Transition Rules
fields.description: Rules for how states are transitions, like next state and which role is allowed to change state etc.

fields.label: Transitions
fields.description: Rules defining transition of state in the workflow.

fields.label: Workflow State Field
fields.description: Field that represents the Workflow State of the transaction (if field is not present, a new hidden Custom Field will be created)
